classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught frequency-table algorithm by forming score-frequency products, summing products and frequencies separately, and dividing to obtain each mean.

content.prompt: Calculate the mean from these frequency tables.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2a frequency table and complete dotted product/totals extension.
spec.description: Solid two-column given table. Complete blank dotted product column, blank header, seven response rows and a totals extension under f and fx only.
spec.answerVisibility: Student-visible givens and blank scaffold only. All products, totals and mean remain in editable answer.short/answer.worked.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2b frequency table and incomplete dotted extension starters.
spec.description: Solid two-column given table. Exactly three short horizontal dotted starters at the top, header baseline and first data-row baseline, plus two short vertical dotted continuations below f. No completed product column, header, totals boxes or totals labels.
spec.answerVisibility: Student-visible givens and blank scaffold only. All products, totals and mean remain in editable answer.short/answer.worked.

answer.worked:
The $xf$ column is $0, 10, 70, 165, 120, 100$.

$$\begin{align*}\sum f&=4+2+7+11+6+4\\\sum f&=34\\\sum xf&=0+10+70+165+120+100\\\sum xf&=465\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\sum xf}{\sum f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{465}{34}\\\bar{x}&\approx13.68\end{align*}$$

The decimal approximation is to 2 decimal places.
